claim: Node #115 routine 0x5d5a720 destroys a holder's string-carrying linked list and then clears and frees the holder's buffer: per 0x68-byte node it disposes two strings under the short-form rule and frees the node, then it memsets the buffer span, zeroes holder+0x10 and holder+0x18, and frees the buffer span unless begin equals holder+0x30. The holder itself is never freed.

buffer_phase.buffer_free: sized delete of (begin, [holder+0x08] * 8) via the _ZdlPvm PLT 0x63f0d80, tail-jumped, unless begin equals holder+0x30
buffer_phase.inline_storage_compare: begin compared against holder+0x30; equal returns plainly

callees.0x63f0a90: memset PLT: buffer-span clear in the exit phase
callees.0x63f0d80: _ZdlPvm PLT: sized delete used for every string, node and buffer free in this routine

list_phase.null_head: skips the list loop and still runs the buffer phase

per_node_in_order.short_form_rule: pointer equal to node+0x40 frees nothing, else sized delete of (pointer, capacity + 1)
pointer equal to node+0x20 frees nothing, else sized delete of (pointer, capacity + 1)

unknowns: Source-level types of the holder, the list nodes and the two strings per node; only sizes, strides and offsets are pinned.

The source meaning of holder+0x18 (zeroed in the buffer phase) and of the holder+0x30 begin comparison beyond the observed inline-storage-shaped test; only the comparison and the exact free size are pinned.
What the callers do with the holder before or after the call, and what the list nodes represent.
Node fields outside +0x00/+0x10/+0x20/+0x30/+0x40 are never read by this routine; their roles are not claimed.

The null-begin buffer-phase case: the code memsets and conditionally frees through a null begin pointer when count is zero; behavior for a null begin with a nonzero count is not pinned and is not modelled.
